# Intention

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Intention`](gmeow-Intention.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Intention>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/teleology`](../../slices/teleology.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An intentional mode of internal commitment — the agent has settled on pursuing the goal (UFO-C: intention), though no other agent holds them to it. Inheres in exactly one agent ([`gmeow:intentBearer`](../properties/gmeow-intentBearer.md)); aims at exactly one goal ([`gmeow:intentionGoal`](../properties/gmeow-intentionGoal.md)); may motivate events ([`gmeow:motivates`](../properties/gmeow-motivates.md)). The social grade — committed TOWARD someone — is [`gmeow:Commitment`](gmeow-Commitment.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:IntentionalMode`](gmeow-IntentionalMode.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Intention`](gmeow-Intention.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:IntentionalMode`](gmeow-IntentionalMode.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

### Goal And Intention

- **Source:** [`slices/core/teleology/examples/goal-and-intention.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/teleology/examples/goal-and-intention.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-teleology-examples-goal-and-intention)#example-slices-core-teleology-examples-goal-and-intention

```turtle
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Blackcat Informatics® Inc. <paudley@blackcatinformatics.ca>
# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0
#
# Worked example: goals, intentions, and commitments. GMEOW separates the
# intentional moments gUFO keeps distinct: a gmeow:Goal is the SocialObject an
# agent aims at (gmeow:hasGoal); a gmeow:Intention is an intentional MODE borne by
# an agent that aims at that goal (gmeow:intentionGoal) and MOTIVATES concrete
# action (gmeow:motivates → an Event); a gmeow:Commitment is a relator binding a
# committed agent to a beneficiary. The desire-to / intend-to / commit-to layers
# are not collapsed — each is its own first-class moment.
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/teleology/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .

# --- The intention: an intentional mode borne by Dana, aimed at the goal, that
#     motivates a concrete action (the graduation event).
ex:intention a gmeow:Intention ;
    gmeow:intentBearer  ex:dana ;
    gmeow:intentionGoal ex:degreeGoal ;
    gmeow:motivates     ex:graduation .
```

## Common Companion Terms

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when an agent has internally settled on pursuing a goal but no other agent holds them to it — the middle commitment grade, and the natural source of [`gmeow:motivates`](../properties/gmeow-motivates.md) on the events the agent undertakes.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for mere wanting (use [`gmeow:Desire`](gmeow-Desire.md)) and for resolutions made TOWARD another agent (use [`gmeow:Commitment`](gmeow-Commitment.md), a relator); a resolution made purely to oneself is an [`Intention`](gmeow-Intention.md), not a [`Commitment`](gmeow-Commitment.md).

### How to use

- Mint an [`Intention`](gmeow-Intention.md) with one [`gmeow:intentBearer`](../properties/gmeow-intentBearer.md) and one [`gmeow:intentionGoal`](../properties/gmeow-intentionGoal.md); link the actions it explains with [`gmeow:motivates`](../properties/gmeow-motivates.md), and record adoption or abandonment over time as a [`gmeow:IntentionTenure`](gmeow-IntentionTenure.md) rather than mutating the mode.

### Examples

- ex:planToShip a [`gmeow:Intention`](gmeow-Intention.md); [`gmeow:intentBearer`](../properties/gmeow-intentBearer.md) ex:lillith; [`gmeow:intentionGoal`](../properties/gmeow-intentionGoal.md) ex:reachOrbit; [`gmeow:motivates`](../properties/gmeow-motivates.md) ex:launchPrep.
